title: wiki issue.id is the full UUID; links need the short key
description:
Researcher first-pass.

In templates, issue.id renders as WIKI-650fd91d-7f3b-427e-aa7f-253b228b48d9. `kbs list` shows 650fd9. Wiki-to-story links need the short key.

Product rule: expose the same short identifier list/show use (issue.key or issue.short_id). Keep the full id available. Do not make agents substring UUIDs in templates.
